biggest_catch: Southern California water-agency customers only — and the rebates vary by agency and available funding, so confirm your agency's current amounts before buying. These rebates lower the cost of water-efficient upgrades; they're not cash you can spend anywhere.
catches: You must be served by a participating SoCal WaterSmart member water agency in Southern California.
Rebate amounts start at $85 for clothes washers, $40 for premium high-efficiency toilets, and $2 per sprinkler nozzle (minimum 30) — but amounts vary by agency and funding availability.
Some rebates may require pre-approval or inspection before purchase/installation.
Funding is limited; rebates can be reduced or suspended when program funds run out.
Products must meet the program's qualifying model lists.

steps: Confirm your home is served by a participating SoCal WaterSmart member water agency (check on the program site).
Pick a qualifying product: high-efficiency clothes washer ($85+), premium high-efficiency toilet ($40), or 30+ sprinkler nozzles ($2 each).
Check whether your agency requires pre-approval before you buy.
Buy and install the qualifying product; keep your receipt.
Submit your rebate claim on the SoCal WaterSmart site with your receipt and agency account info.
timing: Rebate paid after your claim is reviewed and approved.
